Initial fix added a toast on every action ("advanced to step 2, next follow-up Wed Jun 5") so the user knows where the contact went. That only covers cases where the user took an action. Your actual report -- "I was literally working in a contact and then the page refreshed and that contact is gone" -- was a different bug: the auto-refresh on tab focus was wholesale-replacing the contacts list, so if the contact you were editing fell out of the queue between refreshes it vanished mid-edit. Real fix (commit 2393ff3): the auto-refresh now pins any contact with an open draft edit, pending campaign choice, or in-flight action. They stay at the top of the list even if they fall out of the server response, with a notice "Queue refreshed -- kept N contacts you're working on."
Action for you: Try this: open a contact, start editing the draft, switch tabs (e.g., to LinkedIn), come back. Confirm the contact is still in the queue with your edits intact. If you ever see a contact disappear after the fix, screenshot it + tell us the contact ID so we can investigate.
